senses.sense_definition: The act of struggling to escape or emerge from a difficulty or state of distress.

examples.text: The scholar described the long <w>eluctation</w> of the movement from its initial obscurity into the light of public recognition.
After years of <w>eluctation</w> against poverty, the family finally managed to secure a stable life in the city.

traits.comment: This term is rarely used in modern English and is primarily found in historical or literary texts.
